uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

574-6972-8329--225.easyPrerequisites: The Zombie Cat doesn't have a -1/-1 counter on it and has base toughness 2 or greater.
574-6972-8329--225.description:
Activate Vish Kal by sacrificing the Zombie Cat.
When the Zombie Cat dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the Zombie Cat enters, Olag and Miau's first and second abilities trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on the Zombie Cat.
Resolve the second trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on either a Zombie or Cat you control.
Resolve the Vish Kal ability, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Vish Kal equal to the sacrificed creature's power
Repeat.
574-6972-8329--225.notes:
You can use either Olag and Miau trigger to put a +1/+1 counter on the Zombie Cat. The other ability can put the counter on any Zombie or Cat you control depending on which trigger is left.
Once Vish Kal has infinite +1/+1 counters, you may activate its last ability any number of times to reduce the toughnesses of any number of creatures to 0.

2023-4518-6723-7175.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying its mana cost.
Aragorn triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token.
When Kor Skyfisher enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Kor Skyfisher and the Human Soldier token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1339-2292-2835.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
1339-2292-2835.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Fecundity triggers, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

2292-4419-4694-7306.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
2292-4419-4694-7306.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Renata.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, scrying 1.
Repeat from step 1.

586-5011-5406-6495.description:
Activate Dinosaur Headdress' equip ability by paying {2}, attaching it to Priest of Gix and causing Priest of Gix to become a copy of Cavalier of Night.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, its second ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Evereth ability
Repeat.
586-5011-5406-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

1169-3259-3699.notablePrerequisites:
At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
You control a creature token.
1169-3259-3699.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Cadira, triggering Breath of Fury and Cadira.
Resolve the Cadira trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

215-5614-7296.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with power 7 or greater.
215-5614-7296.description:
Activate Bighorner Rancher by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Bighorner Rancher from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Bighorner Rancher by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

670-1619-5887-6151.notablePrerequisites: You are currently venturing in Tomb of Annihilation in the Trapped Entry room.
670-1619-5887-6151.description:
Cast Werefox Bodyguard by paying its mana cost.
When Werefox Bodyguard enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Werefox Bodyguard trigger, exiling Underdark Explorer until Werefox Bodyguard leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Werefox Bodyguard.
Werefox Bodyguard leaves the battlefield, causing Underdark Explorer to be returned to the battlefield from exile.
When Underdark Explorer enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Underdark Explorer trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Werefox Bodyguard from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Werefox Bodyguard enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Werefox Bodyguard trigger, exiling Underdark Explorer until Werefox Bodyguard leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 10, venturing into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 6, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Werefox Bodyguard.
Repeat from step 5.

uses.exileCardState: exiled on a previous turn by its paradigm ability

141-1409-2060-7453.manaNeeded: {1}{U} plus {3}{G}{G} if Germination Practicum is in your hand
141-1409-2060-7453.description:
If Germination Practicum is in your hand, cast Germination Practicum by paying {3}{G}{G}. Otherwise, at the beginning of your precombat main phase, choose to cast a copy of it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, activate Naru Meha by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Naru Meha enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, pairing it and Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Germination Practicum.
Resolve the copy of Germination Practicum, putting two +1/+1 counters on each creature you control.
Holding priority, activate Crystalline Crawler twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat from step 2.

140-3245-4860.description:
Activate Moltensteel Dragon by paying life.
Repeat step 1 as desired.
Activate Rowan by tapping it, reducing the cost of all black and/or red spells you cast this turn.
Cast Exsanguinate, choosing for X to equal the amount of life you've lost this turn, but paying a total of {B}{B} due to Rowan.
Resolve Exsanguinate, causing each opponent to lose X life, and you to gain life equal to the life lost this way.

uses.n: Tetzin, Gnome Champion // The Golden-Gear Colossus

486-933-2388-6587.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill The Golden-Gear Colossus.
486-933-2388-6587.description:
Activate Liquimetal Torque by tapping it, causing Ultimecia, Time Sorceress to become an artifact.
Declare The Golden-Gear Colossus as an attacker. It triggers, creating two 1/1 Gnome artifact creature tokens and transforming Ultimecia, Time Sorceress into Ultimecia, Omnipotent.
Ultimecia, Omnipotent triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Conjurer's Closet triggers, blinking Ultimecia, Omnipotent. It'll enter the battlefield as Ultimecia, Time Sorceress.
When Ultimecia, Time Sorceress enters, it triggers, causing you to surveil 2.
Repeat each turn.

2279-2511-7084.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Quintorius triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

372-3277-7174.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Personify exiled by Abdel Adrian.
372-3277-7174.description:
Cast Personify by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Izzet Chronarch and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Izzet Chronarch trigger.
Resolve the Izzet Chronarch trigger, returning Personify from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Personify.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Izzet Chronarch and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

527-542-1322.notablePrerequisites:
You have a creature card in hand that can be cast using only colored mana.
Selvala can tap to produce at least {1}{G}{G}{G} plus enough mana to cast the other creature card.
527-542-1322.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{G}{G}{G} plus enough mana to cast a creature card from your hand.
Cast a creature card by paying its mana cost.
Tidespout Tyrant triggers, returning Selvala from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Selvala by paying {1}{G}{G}.
Tidespout Tyrant triggers, returning the creature cast in step 2 from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

3918-3941-4824.description:
Activate Trazyn using Coveted Jewel's ability by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Trazyn using Soliton's ability by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.

2624-5256-6481.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing God-Eternal Oketra.
When God-Eternal Oketra dies, it triggers, putting itself into your library third from the top.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing you to mill cards equal to God-Eternal Oketra's power, ultimately milling God-Eternal Oketra.
Colossal Grave-Reaver's second ability triggers, putting God-Eternal Oketra from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
Repeat.

uses.n: Emet-Selch, Unsundered // Hades, Sorcerer of Eld

4377-6333-6335.manaNeeded: {1}{W} plus enough mana to cast the extra turn spell each turn
4377-6333-6335.easyPrerequisites: Robe of Stars attached to Hades.
4377-6333-6335.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons from your graveyard by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, activate Robe of Stars by paying {1}{W}, phasing out Hades.
Resolve Walk the Aeons, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
During your extra turn, Hades phases in during your untap step.
Repeat.

1575-2815-5903.description:
Activate Professional Face-Breaker by sacrificing a Treasure, which is also a Food due to Gourmand's Talent.
Nuka-Cola Vending Machine triggers, creating a tapped Treasure token.
Resolve the Professional Face-Breaker ability, exiling the top card of your library with the ability to play it until end of turn.
Repeat.

862-2921-5220-5683.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Crimson Kobolds.
When Crimson Kobolds dies, Mortuary and Remembrance trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Crimson Kobolds from your graveyard on top of your library.
Resolve the Remembrance trigger, searching your library for Crimson Kobolds and putting it into your hand.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Crimson Kobolds by paying {0}.
Repeat.

1492-4211-5660-5943.notablePrerequisites:
There is at least one additional artifact on the battlefield.
One of the self-sacrificing artifacts must be in your hand, with the other in your graveyard.
1492-4211-5660-5943.description:
Cast the self-sacrificing artifact in your hand by paying {0}.
Ms. Bumbleflower triggers, causing an opponent to draw a card, and then putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning the self-sacrificing artifact from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate the self-sacrificing artifact cast in step 1 by sacrificing it, and paying other costs if necessary.
Repeat.

2085-5329-5475.description:
Activate either of the creatures by tapping it, targeting the other creature.
If the tapped creature was a Merfolk, Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve the ability from step 1, untapping the targeted creature.
Repeat.

168-526-2557-5193.manaNeeded: {2}{W}{B}{G} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
168-526-2557-5193.description:
Cast Anikthea from your hand or from the command zone by paying {2}{W}{B}{G} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Anikthea enters the battlefield, it and Life Finds a Way trigger.
Resolve the Anikthea trigger, exiling Oblivion Ring from your graveyard and creating two token copies of it that are 3/3 Zombies.
When the Oblivion Ring tokens enter the battlefield, their first abilities trigger.
Resolve the first Oblivion Ring trigger, exiling Anikthea until the Oblivion Ring token leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the second Oblivion Ring trigger, exiling the first Oblivion Ring token.
When the first Oblivion Ring token is exiled, Anikthea returns to the battlefield from exile.
When Anikthea enters the battlefield, it and Life Finds a Way trigger.
Resolve the Anikthea trigger, choosing not to exile anything.
Resolve the Life Finds a Way trigger, creating two token copies of the Oblivion Ring token.
Repeat from step 4.

2034-2178-3621-4331.notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Drafna.
Drafna does not have summoning sickness.
2034-2178-3621-4331.description:
Cast Su-Chi Cave Guard by paying {8}.
Holding priority, activate Drafna's second ability by paying {3} and tapping it, copying the Su-Chi Cave Guard spell.
Resolve the copy of the Su-Chi Cave Guard spell.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Su-Chi Cave Guard token, adding {C}{C}.
When the token Su-Chi Cave Guard dies, it and Drafna trigger.
Resolve the Su-Chi Cave Guard trigger, adding eight {C}.
Resolve the Drafna trigger, untapping it.
Repeat from step 2.

647-797-2105.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block the creature with Stolen Identity encoded and Combat Celebrant.
Stolen Identity encoded on a creature you control other than Combat Celebrant.
647-797-2105.description:
Declare Combat Celebrant and the creature with Stolen Identity encoded as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using the creature that has Stolen Identity encoded.
Stolen Identity triggers, casting a copy of itself without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Stolen Identity, creating a token copy of Combat Celebrant.
Repeat each combat phase using the Combat Celebrant token instead.

512-1719-4050.notablePrerequisites: Vizier of Tumbling Sands does not have summoning sickness.
512-1719-4050.description:
Activate Vizier of Tumbling Sands by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.
Holding priority, activate Halo Fountain's first ability by paying {W}, tapping it and untapping Vizier of Tumbling Sands, creating a 1/1 Citizen creature token.
Resolve the Vizier of Tumbling Sands ability, untapping Halo Fountain.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Citizen token, adding {W}.
Repeat.

11-3584-4276.notablePrerequisites: Lands (or artifacts, or creatures) sufficient to produce {2}{U}{U}{U}{U}.
11-3584-4276.description:
Cast Turnabout.
Thousand-Year Storm triggers.
Allow any Turnabout copies to resolve, maintaining the original.
Cast Narset's Reversal targeting Turnabout.
Thousand-Year Storm triggers.
Have at least one copy of Narset's Reversal target the original Narset's Reversal.
When that copy of Narset's Reversal resolves, target the original Turnabout with the new copy of Narset's Reversal created.
When that new copy of Narset's Reversal to resolves, target yourself with the copy of Turnabout.
When it resolves, untap all lands (or artifacts, or creatures) you control.
Repeat.

1776-2757.notablePrerequisites: Spawning Grounds is attached to a basic land you control.
1776-2757.description:
Activate the enchanted basic land by tapping it, creating a 5/5 green Beast creature token with trample.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping an untapped creature you control, untapping the enchanted basic land.
Repeat.

2820-3175-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Sun Titan.
When Sun Titan dies, Angelic Renewal triggers, causing you to sacrifice Angelic Renewal and return Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Angelic Renewal from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.
